attributes.name: Druva - Newly Observed Administrator Login
attributes.description: Detects an administrator whose first observed login appears during the current observation window.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator whose first observed login appears during the current observation window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    TO_STRING(source.ip)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE admin IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    first_seen =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_seen =
      MAX(event_time),

    login_count =
      COUNT(*),

    ip_addresses =
      VALUES(login_ip),

    locations =
      VALUES(location),

    first_ip =
      FIRST(login_ip, event_time),

    first_location =
      FIRST(location, event_time)

  BY admin

| EVAL minutes_since_first_seen =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_seen,
      NOW()
    )

| WHERE minutes_since_first_seen <= 60
